description: Tests for staff removal via remove_immortal() and remove_staff_status()

tests.name: remove_staff_status_resets_rank
tests.description: remove_staff_status() clears immortal record for a non-existent pfile

tests.name: remove_immortal_not_in_list
tests.description: remove_immortal() on an immortal not in the list does not crash

tests.name: remove_staff_status_empty_name
tests.description: remove_staff_status with empty/NULL name does not crash

tests.name: account_entry_updated_on_removal
tests.description: remove_staff_status() sets ACCOUNT_CHARACTER staff=false and staff_rank=0

tests.name: account_flag_cleared_last_staff
tests.description: ACCT_CAN_CREATE_STAFF cleared when last staff character removed

tests.name: sdemote_to_player_triggers_removal
tests.description: do_sdemote to 'player' rank triggers full staff removal via remove_staff_status

tests.name: sdemote_below_gimp_allowed
tests.description: do_sdemote below STAFF_GIMP (to player) is now allowed — old floor removed

tests.name: offline_char_removal
tests.description: remove_staff_status correctly removes staff from offline character without re-creation
